message: ForAllValues:StringEquals on aws:TagKeys allows an empty tag set (vacuous truth). A caller can invoke CreateSecret with no tags and the condition passes, bypassing tagging governance. Add a Null check on aws:TagKeys.

Use the operator type Boolean instead of operator string for the condition key secretsmanager:ForceOverwriteReplicaSecret. [TYPE_MISMATCH] See: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access-analyzer-reference-policy-checks.html#access-analyzer-reference-policy-checks-general-warning-type-mismatch
